drivingQuestion: Was the land of the nations decreed impure due to its air or its earth?
outcomeNote: The dilemma is taken up in the next unit.

segments.he: וְאֶרֶץ הָעַמִּים. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: אֶרֶץ הָעַמִּים, מִשּׁוּם אַוֵּירָא גָּזְרוּ עָלֶיהָ, אוֹ דִילְמָא מִשּׁוּם גּוּשָּׁא גָּזְרוּ עָלֶיהָ?
segments.en: § The mishna further taught: «And the land of the nations» does not render a nazirite obligated to shave, despite the fact that it is considered ritually impure. The Gemara inquires with regard to the nature of this impurity. «A dilemma was raised before» the Sages: Did the Sages «decree the land of the nations» impure «with regard to the air,» i.e., is one rendered impure merely by being there? «Or perhaps they decreed» it impure «with regard to the earth,» i.e., one who touches the ground or overlays it becomes impure.
